title: Full work with a map on a tablet
description: Creating, rearranging, links and export in one comfortable space.

blocks.text: A tablet is sometimes the main tool. Being able only to look at a map does not cover the work of a person who studies or writes on it.

quote.text: You removed my ability to use the iPad app even with a PAID account. There for, you lost a 5+ year paid user. Horrible decision you made, and you blame Apple for hurting your loyal customers, when the decision was yours.

blocks.text: Design the whole cycle for touch, stylus and keyboard. Test the actions on a map that has been filled in, not only on an empty screen.
Show the terms of personal access and the differences between platforms clearly. A mobile plan should not promise actions that are only available in another version.
